title: /cost should show the last x sessions too
body:
Thanks for the amazing tool!

Currently there are many situations where I have to close and reopen the claude tool. This loses the context of the cost in the session. Ideally, Claude will keep track of the cost in the last x sessions, or the total cost in the last x days, on a day granularity, and expose this in the `/cost` command.
author: niyazpk
